notes: Summary: Sunridge explored Redwood to power customer-facing chat + embedding-driven order search. Strong product fit functionally, but economics are the blocker.

POC (Nov-Dec 2025): 3-week pilot integrating hosted API into 'order-assist' flow. Achieved P50 latency ~220ms for chat path, embeddings similarity acceptable for rerank. SE setup and telemetry checked out.

Key objection: unit cost vs incumbent. Finance ran a 12-month run-rate and Redwood-hosted token estimates came in ~2x the incumbent (incumbent secured deep enterprise commit). Sunridge needs <$0.07/1k tokens equivalent to hit unit margin; Redwood landed at ~$0.12/1k in POC profile.

Dedicated option: Redwood proposed Dedicated with reserved GPU pools. Tech validated throughput but required minimum monthly commit of $35k -> finance said too high given current runway. Wanted < $25k commit or ability to start smaller with burst.

Security: initial security review found good SOC2 scope but asked for stronger KMS/HSM integration and explicit EU data residency for EU customers. Legal flagged these as must-haves for enterprise rollouts.
Org changes: Product lead who championed the POC was promoted to platform org in Jan and is no longer actively driving procurement. No clear internal owner now.

Competitive pressure: OpenAI enterprise offered a stepped commit discount + flexible model routing; procurement preferred their pricing structure. Sunridge explicitly said 'we can get similar UX at half the run-rate with an incumbent commitment'.
- 2025-11-03: Intro call (AE Priya) - requirements: sub-200ms p50, embed-based rerank, SSO+KMS.
- 2025-11-14: Technical deep-dive (SE Diego) - passed QA, recommended batching and cache config.
- 2025-12-01: POC kickoff - 3-week data ingest + traffic replay.
- 2025-12-22: POC wrap - metrics shared (latency, RU, token burn). Finance asked for 12-month cost projection.
- 2026-01-08: Pricing review call - offered Dedicated with $35k/month minimum + 6% discount on tokens vs hosted. Sunridge asks for lower commit or pilot tier.
- 2026-01-12: Final internal: procurement decides to go with incumbent commit; account put on hold. AE notified.

Next steps / closing: Account is effectively stalled/closed-lost for now. AE to keep on watchlist; re-engage if budget reopens or if Redwood offers lower commit pilot. Suggested playbook if re-engage: propose a 3-month pilot at reduced commit, temporary token rebates tied to usage, and a remediation plan for KMS + EU residency commitments.
Stated quote from product lead at close: 'Technically you nailed it — economics simply don't make sense for our margins right now.'
Actions logged: SE created SEC-881 for KMS questions, pricing escalation note in CRM, recommended product team consider a smaller Dedicated pilot SKU for accounts in this band.
